name: gitea-lens
description: Self-hosted CI/CD and pull-request operations console for Gitea

scripts.start:api: bash -c 'cfg="${LENS_CONFIG:-}"; if [ -z "$cfg" ]; then if [ -f config.yaml ]; then cfg=config.yaml; else cfg=config.example.yaml; fi; fi; exec go run ./cmd/lens serve --config "$cfg"'
scripts.restart: npm run stop && npm run start
